verdict.rationale: The Division documents a fax filing channel ("To submit a fax filing, use our modernized application: New Jersey Fax Filing") and names some paper forms (CD-100, CD-101), so a non-portal rail exists. However, no fax numbers, mailing addresses, or complete form list appear in the evidence, and the fax rail is itself reached through an online application. missing for 10: published mailing address for paper filings, published fax numbers, complete list of downloadable paper forms per filing type, evidence that the fallback works when online systems are down, independent corroboration.
